findings: Actual result and source boundary (REVIEWED-RESULT-SUBJECT.json, SOURCE-IDENTITY-AND-INTEGRATION-GUARD.json, source-review-packet/proposal/candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/init.rs, source-review-packet/proposal/candidate/crates/mori/tests/init.rs): init::project returns source.mori, scenario.json, mori-tests.json, and README.md for Template::Transfer (action pay, amount 25) and Template::Repay (action repay, amount 30; seed declared only) using asset TEST (network local, issuer mori-init-example, reference TEST, scale 0) validated via mori_core::parse, serde_json::from_value, and mori_core::json::export before init::run executes std::fs::create_dir(&args.dir) and OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true) (with no quote_arg helper or create_dir_all). actual-cycle/red/{START.json,RESULT.json,STDOUT.log} records the historical a1 single-test RED failure (0 passed, 1 failed, 7 filtered out; child shell exit 127 on bare mori with empty PATH, Cargo exit 101), while actual-cycle/green/{START.json,RESULT.json,STDOUT.log} runs the updated a2 tests/init.rs across the full target with 8 passed, 0 failed, and 0 filtered out (Cargo exit 0); actual-cycle/GREEN-CANDIDATE.json is an earlier unrun a1 preparation record and not GREEN's source identity.

Current public path quoting, destination refusal atomicity, and shell assertion (init::run in crates/mori/src/commands/init.rs, crates/mori/tests/init.rs, actual-cycle/green/STDERR.log): init::run resolves std::env::current_exe(), enforces UTF-8 via to_str(), and formats the executable path as a single POSIX shell word via format!("'{}'", executable.replace('\'', "'\\''")) prior to std::fs::create_dir(&args.dir). In generated_commands_use_the_creating_rust_cli_without_path_lookup, the a2 test resolves and canonicalizes sh from the host PATH before clearing child PATH, copies mori into "Rust CLI's tools 🧪", initializes transfer (cli-574969-19) and repay (cli-574969-21) with PATH="", and runs the README.md sh block under /usr/bin/dash -c with set -e and PATH="" (cli-574969-20 and cli-574969-22), each emitting 3 JSON reports (check, simulate, test) under moriarty/1 and moriarty-core/1 local-reference-execution. Companion tests verify exact bytes for relative Unicode/metacharacter paths (default_matches_explicit_transfer_and_relative_unicode_names_are_only_paths), non-destructive refusal on existing empty/populated directories, files, missing parents, and live/dangling/directory symlinks, and single-winner race creation (competing_inits_have_one_complete_winner_without_overwrite), where actual-cycle/green/STDERR.log records one child creating .../mori-init-574969-13/race and the competing child refusing destination-directory creation with File exists (os error 17) before cli-574969-14 passes.

Finite independent finance scope and consumer verification (actual-cycle/green/INDEPENDENT-FINANCIAL-COMPARISON.json, FROZEN-POST-EFFECTS-PROJECTION.json, FINANCIAL-CAPTURE-INDEX.json, source-review-packet/PUBLIC-CONSUMER-EXCERPTS.md): Root's 13 mechanical matches in INDEPENDENT-FINANCIAL-COMPARISON.json verify complete post and ordered effects equality against the first pre-execution freeze (clean-devex-fresh-independent-oracles/transfer.expected.json and repay.expected.json) for Transfer25 (alice 75, bob 25) and Repay30 (alice 70, bob 30, residual debt 70). In both_starters_check_simulate_and_test_with_complete_literal_expectations, crates/mori/src/commands/test.rs enforces post == &actual.post && effects == &actual.effects and rejects mutated 999 amounts in either field (cli-574969-5, cli-574969-6, cli-574969-11, cli-574969-12). The separate extra freeze (clean-devex-init-extra-independent-oracles) aligns with observed full repayment of 100 in cli-574969-36/stdout (alice 0, bob 100, zero-amount debt tombstone retained) and the three atomic refusals in cli-574969-37, cli-574969-40, and cli-574969-41 (no execution field and opening scenario preserved in repayment_full_tombstone_and_overdischarge_preserve_atomic_reference_results and transfer_zero_and_unfunded_are_exact_reference_refusals); candidate expected() in tests/init.rs is producer-authored, and full Execution wire bytes, per-step snapshots/values, ExprId numbering, source_hash, exact error codes, logical cost assertions, and CLI rendering are not independently oracle-qualified.

Captures, bounded cleanup, platform scope, and retained source-owner advisory dispositions (CAPTURE-INDEX.json, actual-cycle/red/{PROCESS-CLEANUP.json,CLEANUP.json}, actual-cycle/green/{PROCESS-CLEANUP.json,CLEANUP.json}, a2-source-reviews/doctorwatson-clean-starter-source-security-fallback-20261018-a2/WHOLE-SCHEMA-VALID-CANDIDATES.json): GREEN records 34 top-level cli-574969-* capture directories and 21 parsed top-level JSON reports; cli-574969-13 is absent because NEXT index 13 was consumed by Files::new() for the race test temporary root while the two competing race init processes were spawned directly via Command::spawn() outside invoke(), and shell wrapper captures cli-574969-20 and cli-574969-22 each ran 3 nested mori commands. PROCESS-CLEANUP.json and CLEANUP.json in RED and GREEN verify only that owned session IDs (562357 and 572783) had empty member lists and owned /tmp roots were removed (existsAfter: false), not syscall-level or detached-descendant exclusion. Runtime evidence is Linux with /usr/bin/dash only, with no Windows or Git Bash qualification. The designated a2 source owner's explicit classification of control/backtick characters in current_exe() README.md presentation and non-UTF-8 OsStr path unit-test coverage as advisory limitations rather than mandatory changes is retained without promoting source review receipts into result votes.

Guarded integration and non-transferability of prior result reviews (REVIEWED-RESULT-SUBJECT.json, SOURCE-IDENTITY-AND-INTEGRATION-GUARD.json, PACKET-NOTE.json): This approval covers only the exact observed a2 candidate source and green test tree bound by REVIEWED-RESULT-SUBJECT.json alongside the 18 unchanged public consumer and guideline files pinned in SOURCE-IDENTITY-AND-INTEGRATION-GUARD.json. Both a1 result review contexts under original-result-reviews/ remain physical evidence only and are ineligible as replacement votes for the modified a2 test source and 8-test execution scope. Because main may advance (including via PR210 or separate Core2 tests/fixtures), integration remains guarded: root alone verifies actual current main and selected source/dependency identities, determines whether rebasing or changed-byte re-review is required, and holds sole disposition and integration authority.
limitations: Independent financial comparison in actual-cycle/green/INDEPENDENT-FINANCIAL-COMPARISON.json covers complete post and ordered effects across 13 Transfer25/Repay30 observations from the first freeze, while the extra freeze covers full repayment (100) and three refusal scenarios; candidate expected() in crates/mori/tests/init.rs is not independent, and full Execution wire payloads, per-step traces, ExprId allocations, source_hash, exact error codes, logical work meters, and CLI rendering are not independently oracle-qualified.

RED (actual-cycle/red) executed the historical a1 single-test filter whereas GREEN (actual-cycle/green) executed all 8 tests on the updated a2 crates/mori/tests/init.rs (which changed host sh resolution); RED and GREEN test sources are not byte-identical, and actual-cycle/GREEN-CANDIDATE.json is an unrun historical a1 preparation record.

The 34 top-level capture directories under actual-cycle/green/cli-captures reflect invoke() wrapper calls rather than a full OS process census (two shell wrappers each execute 3 nested Rust commands, and two race children use direct Command::spawn() after Files::new() consumes NEXT index 13). PROCESS-CLEANUP.json and CLEANUP.json verify only owned session emptiness and owned temporary directory removal, not detached-process or syscall exclusion.

Observed runtime execution is restricted to Linux with /usr/bin/dash (--no-default-features); no Windows, cmd.exe, PowerShell, or Git Bash execution was observed, and designated a2 source-owner dispositions regarding control/backtick characters in std::env::current_exe() README presentation and non-UTF-8 OsStr path unit testing remain advisory limitations.

This review is strictly bounded to the SDK-free moriarty/1 and moriarty-core/1 starter CLI result in REVIEWED-RESULT-SUBJECT.json with no product reruns or repository mutations; it confers no future-merge approval if main advances, no cryptographic/SDK/VM/proof/ledger/wallet qualification, and no U0-U7/M/MC/SP/G/C4/k17 gate closure.
